name: Rewritten
source:
The story follows 16 participants who signed up for a reality TV show for a chance of winning a scholarship. Little do they know, they ended up regaining consciousness in a mysterious hotel. Unbeknownst to them, they are now trapped in a Killing Game where one must kill if they wish to survive.
